entry.title: Vulcan Rotary 1.0.0
entry.summary: # Vulcan Rotary 1.0.0 A six-barrel rotary gate and stutter. The barrels spool up from rest and the rate is in real gun rounds per minute (2,500 / 4,000 / 6,000 / 7,200). Modes: Free, Input (your signal is the power supply) and Fire (automatable trigger). 13 programs. **Not yet tested on a real MPC** (checked with Akai's `host_sim` and Open MPC's catalog check). Reports welcome: device, MPC OS version, what happened. Two zips: `*-mpc-armv7.zip` for Gen1 (Live, Live II, One, X, Key 61/37, Force) a
